stories.title: Trial set for Kentucky woman accused of vandalizing WWII Memorial in Washington D.C.
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors allege Farris livestreamed herself vandalizing the World War II Memorial on the National Mall on Aug. 13.

stories.title: 'Remember all the good times.' | Stooges closing sale begins
stories.summary: NASCAR hoods and volleyballs flew out the door. You could buy the main neon sign outside as the liquidation sale continues this week.

stories.title: Kentucky prepares 1,500 truck fleet for winter weather season
stories.summary: As snow and ice season approaches, state officials are reminding drivers to use caution and check road conditions before traveling.

stories.title: Restrooms temporarily closed at Waverly Park after vandalism
stories.summary: Jefferson Memorial Forest and Natural Areas said the restrooms experienced “significant vandalism” and will be closed until repairs are complete.

stories.title: FEMA approves more than $38M in disaster aid for Kentucky
stories.summary: The funding includes more than $23 million through FEMA’s Public Assistance program, which reimburses communities for disaster-related expenses like debris removal.

stories.title: New initiative offers financial assistance to help Louisville families keep their homes
stories.summary: The program offers assistance with rent, security deposits and utilities for eligible families.

stories.title: Report reveals blockade issues on Louisville ramps after driver goes off interstate
stories.summary: LMPD was called to a report of a vehicle that had left the interstate from I-65 southbound at Hospital Curve at about 1:45 p.m. on Nov. 11.

stories.title: Southern Indiana-based company launches brand aimed at combining pickleball, life's needs
stories.summary: Tetrafab is based in Floyds Knobs. The company is a bag designer and manufacturer who has launched a pickleball lifestyle brand called VENN.

stories.title: 19-year-old arrested after bullet holes, defaced gun found inside UofL student apartment
stories.summary: The police were notified after maintenance found a broken window with what appeared to be a bullet hole through it.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel forecast: Cold, rainy weather expected in Kentucky, southern Indiana
stories.summary: A Weather Impact Alert has been issued due to impacts on Thanksgiving travel plans and outdoor events.

stories.title: Read books, win prizes: Louisville library's adult winter reading program returns Dec. 1
stories.summary: Books & Brews 502 lets adults earn points toward prizes by reading books and visiting local coffee shops and breweries.

stories.title: Farm-raised deer tests positive for Chronic Wasting Disease in this Kentucky county
stories.summary: Deer that appear sick but aren't obviously injured can be reported using an online form.
